title: A deep learning algorithm for detection of oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma from photographic images: A retrospective study.
summary: Specific clinical pathology-reference image validation beyond general architecture benchmarks; source image-level and selection caveats explicitly retained, no patient screening benefit inferred. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
